newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle sales active at $68 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle sales active at $68 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle near midday Tuesday sold at $68.00 per cwt in active trading, down $1.00 from the bulk of last week's sales, but unchanged from light trade on Friday and Monday, feedlot sources said.

About 25,000 slaughter steers and heifers that will likely grade select and choice sold in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma Tuesday on the heels of an estimated 8,000 of the same quality sold late Monday, they said.
An estimated 5,000 head sold in Kansas as owners reluctantly accepted packer bids after earlier holding out for $69.00 to $70.00, cattle feeders there said.
